guide.text: Batman Death Metal's signature gear. Boosts Spiritual Penetration and Spiritual Defense. Summons Blackest Bats at the start of battle. Each Blackest Bat inherits a portion of Batman Death Metal's Attack and HP. Whenever an allied Champion is defeated, Batman Death Metal gains Energy.
